Interview with ‌Jiyong Lee: Glass Artist and Educator Jiyong Lee is renowned for his remarkably smooth,translucent glass sculptures. These pieces are​ inspired by biological processes such as cell division, showcasing a ⁢unique blend of art and science. His segmented sculptures are not only visually stunning but also thought-provoking, inviting viewers to consider​ the intricacies of natural​ processes.
Q&A with​ Jiyong‍ Lee Q: Can you tell us about your artistic journey and how you became interested in glass‍ art? jiyong Lee: ⁣ My fascination with glass art‌ began during my undergraduate studies ‌in ceramics. I was drawn to‍ the translucency and fluidity ⁢of glass, which allowed me to explore forms and light ⁣in ways that⁣ were not possible⁤ with clay. After graduating, I pursued a Master’s degree in glass art, which further honed my skills and deepened my thankfulness‍ for the medium.
Q:⁢ your‌ sculptures are inspired by biological processes. How does this influence your creative process? Jiyong Lee: biological processes, such as cell division, offer a wealth of inspiration for my work.The natural world is filled with intricate patterns and structures that are both stunning and functional. By translating these processes into glass,I aim to highlight the complexity⁣ and elegance ⁢of ‍nature. Each piece is a festivity of the ⁣natural world and a reminder of the interconnectedness of all living ‍things.
Q:‍ You’ve had notable exhibitions like “Segmentation”‍ and “New Work.” How do ‍these exhibitions reflect ‍your ⁤artistic evolution? Jiyong Lee: Exhibitions like‌ “Segmentation” and “New Work” have ⁢been pivotal in my artistic journey.⁣ They allow me to showcase my latest creations and receive feedback from viewers. Each exhibition⁣ represents ‍a progression in my technical⁢ skills and ‍artistic vision. They also ⁤provide an chance to ​engage with the public,fostering a dialog about the intersection of art ⁣and science.
Q:⁤ Your philosophy emphasizes creating memorable experiences for viewers. How do you ⁢achieve this? Jiyong Lee: Creating⁣ memorable experiences for⁣ viewers is at the core of my artistic philosophy. I strive to evoke positive emotions and lasting impressions through my work. By combining technical mastery with a deep appreciation for natural processes, I aim to connect with viewers on a deeper level. My goal ​is ‍to invite them to reflect on the beauty⁤ and complexity of ⁢the natural world.
Q: As an educator, how do you mentor aspiring artists ⁣and help them find their unique voices? Jiyong ⁣Lee: Mentoring aspiring artists is a rewarding⁣ aspect of ⁤my career. I beleive in fostering an surroundings where students can explore their creative potential without fear of failure. by⁤ providing guidance, encouragement, and constructive feedback, I help them develop their skills and find their unique ​voices. my aim⁤ is to equip ‌them with the tools they need to⁤ succeed in‍ their artistic journeys.
Q: What advice​ would you give to aspiring glass artists who ‌are just starting their careers? Jiyong Lee: My advice to aspiring glass artists is to⁢ be persistent and passionate. The journey of mastering glass art is challenging, but⁤ the rewards are immense.⁤ Surround yourself with supportive peers ‌and mentors, and never stop learning. Experiment, take risks, and always strive to improve your craft. Most importantly, stay⁤ true to your artistic ‍vision and let your passion guide you.
Conclusion Jiyong Lee’s contributions to the ⁤world of glass art are significant and far-reaching. ⁣His sculptures, inspired by biological⁤ processes, are technical marvels that ​invite viewers to contemplate the beauty of nature. As an educator, he continues to inspire and mentor the next ⁣generation of artists. Lee’s work is a testament to the power of art ‍to connect,inspire,and educate.
